references.text: The prohibition against making a covenant with the inhabitants of Canaan and their gods was given through Moses before entering the land.
God warned Israel not to make a covenant with the people of the land and commanded them to tear down their altars.
Moses repeated the prohibition against making a covenant with the Canaanite peoples and commanded Israel to tear down their altars.
The command to tear down the altars of the nations when Israel entered the land.
Joshua warned Israel not to make a covenant with the remaining peoples in the land.
The consequence of Israel's disobedience to God's command—the Canaanite peoples would become a snare for them.
The psalmist describes how Israel did not drive out the peoples as the Lord had commanded, but mixed among them.
